propositions: REBAR_LLM_MODEL is a single-scalar knob superseded by per-class model configuration (REBAR_LLM_FRONTIER_MODEL, REBAR_LLM_COMPLETION_MODEL, REBAR_LLM_GATE_MODEL) and must be deprecated to remove ambiguity
Deprecation is registered via _scheduled(...) with permanent=False and remove_in=_MAJOR, establishing a migration window rather than a permanent alias, per parent decision
Within the migration window, REBAR_LLM_MODEL continues to work, maps to all three classes for maximum compatibility, and emits a deprecation warning via warn_deprecated at every env read site
The deprecation warning must be emitted at two independent env-read sites (config.py:469 and a new read in model_classes.py) to ensure coverage on all code paths that resolve the variable
User-facing strings and documentation in six prose files must be updated to present class-based configuration as the current interface and mark REBAR_LLM_MODEL as deprecated
Example configurations for each provider pattern (Anthropic-only, Bedrock-only, mixed-provider, local+fallback) and an ADR documenting the class model and deprecation window must be added to docs
